incoming.explanation: Original pre-1643 Weymouth grants bound arrival below.
The inhabitant-standing conclusion rests on John being an original pre-1643 Weymouth grantee (cross-topic); the manuscript grants (G13-RI-000019) reach the arrival finding through this hop.

Anderson's published 1636 arrival and Boston/Braintree settlement (Weymouth excluded) is the standing published estimate; the pre-1643 Weymouth grants, the 'of Weymouth' 1641 petition, and the post-1640 Great Migration falloff revise the window to 1638-early 1641 and locate his first residence at the Weymouth Anderson omits.
The 1636 householder absence is a cross-topic lower edge on the arrival window developed in the arrival-chronology unit (arrival after 1636).
The timing reading rests on the arrival window (1638-early 1641) fixed in the arrival-chronology unit.
The 1638-early-1641 arrival window bounds the 'gone from English records by c.1641' strand of the profile.

outgoing.explanation: The arrival window rests on the 1641 presence datum.

statement: John Gurney reached New England in 1638–early 1641: bounded below by his original (pre-1643) Weymouth grants and his 1641 presence, and above by the sharp post-1640 falloff of the Great Migration.
